response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software architecture, craftsmanship practices, and experience with complex systems, he lacks the required Spring ecosystem expertise and current JVM/Kotlin focus. His career trajectory has shifted toward TypeScript/Node.js and AI-agent infrastructure, moving away from enterprise Java tooling rather than toward it. The most relevant IDE experience (National Instruments LabWindows/CVI) is 11+ years old.
strengths: Deep commitment to software craftsmanship with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture, and maintainable code practices
Demonstrated ability to design and work with large-scale, complex systems handling millions of requests per second and microservices infrastructure
Strong learning agility across multiple programming languages and domains, with track record of quickly mastering new technical ecosystems
concerns: No demonstrated experience with Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Hibernate, or other enterprise Java frameworks explicitly required for the role
Limited recent Java expertise and no Kotlin experience mentioned; primary focus has shifted to TypeScript/Node.js in last 3+ years
Most relevant IDE/language tooling experience (National Instruments LabWindows C IDE) dates back 11 years; recent work focuses on AI-agent infrastructure unrelated to JVM ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Career Trajectory Away from JVM Ecosystem
